headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 25, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a 2-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance. The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense, led by Dansby Swanson's grand slam and 2 home runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, affecting their teams' lineups. Ryne Nelson (Arizona Diamondbacks) has been transferred to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow. Johan Rojas (Philadelphia Phillies) has been placed on the 60-day injured list for a right elbow UCL repair. Cody Freeman (Texas Rangers) has been placed on the 10-day injured list retroactive to June 22, 2026, with a herniated disc. Marcus Semien (New York Mets) has been placed on the 10-day injured list with a left hip flexor strain.

Several trades and roster moves have taken place. The Chicago Cubs acquired LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis. The St. Louis Cardinals traded RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays for a player to be named later. The Washington Nationals traded SS Marcus Brown to the Houston Astros for cash, while also trading RHP Tyler Schoff to the Atlanta Braves. The Houston Astros traded RHP Jayden Murray to the Chicago Cubs for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Marlins Take Down Rangers in 2-4 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Miami Marlins secured a 2-4 victory over the Texas Rangers, with John King earning the win. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 2-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Dansby Swanson led the charge, hitting a grand slam and collecting 2 home runs, 7 RBIs, and 2 hits in 4 at-bats.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Mets 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 10-5 victory over the New York Mets, with A.J. Ewing leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Huascar Brazobán made a strong pitching appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings without allowing an earned run.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a hard-fought 4-3 win over the Chicago White Sox, with Braden Montgomery leading the offense with a home run and two RBIs. On the mound, Tanner Bibee pitched six strong innings, allowing no earned runs and striking out three.

top_news.title: **Royals Suffer Blowout Loss to Rays**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals fell to the Tampa Bay Rays 13-2 in a one-sided matchup. Impact hitters for the Rays included Carter Jensen, Jonathan Aranda, and Junior Caminero, who all contributed to the team's high-scoring performance.

top_news.title: **Pirates Cruise Past Mariners 5-1**
top_news.summary: The Pittsburgh Pirates secured a convincing 5-1 victory over the Seattle Mariners, handing their opponents their latest loss. Impact performances came from Pirates' catcher Henry Davis and pitcher Bryce Miller, while Mariners' second baseman Brandon Lowe also made a notable contribution.

top_news.title: **Ryne Nelson Shifts to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Arizona Diamondbacks right-hander Ryne Nelson has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to a strained right elbow.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Lefty Starter in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have bolstered their pitching staff with the addition of left-handed pitcher David Peterson, acquired in a trade from the New York Mets.
